notes: UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES — NOT PLAYABLE. Replacement batch for the 26 batch-001 candidates that returned ZERO_RESULTS. No coordinate here is a retry: every candidate is a different place, and all 40 sit at least ~50 km from every batch-001 coordinate (verified or not), so integrating batch 001 cannot create a conflict with this batch. Verification rules are unchanged — source=outdoor, 50 m radius — and every duplicate, cluster and balance gate still applies. Composition method changed in response to the 65% batch-001 failure rate: candidates are now placed along named, long-distance road corridors in countries with dense official coverage, rather than near a settlement or feature name. See the rationale field on each entry.

candidates.label: A3 highway near Motopi
candidates.source: A3 tarred trunk road between Nata and Maun
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Botswana's A-road network is among the better-covered in southern Africa; a numbered trunk road is far likelier to carry a drive than the Kalahari interior did. ~420 km from the batch-001 Kalahari candidate.

candidates.label: N7 through Namaqualand
candidates.source: N7 national route near Springbok, Northern Cape
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. South Africa has the densest official coverage on the continent and the N7 is a primary national route. ~530 km from the batch-001 Karoo candidate.

candidates.label: Winelands outside Stellenbosch
candidates.source: R44 corridor on the edge of Stellenbosch
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban — a setting the Normal tier still needs. ~41 km from the existing Cape Town entry, clear of the 25 km cluster limit.

candidates.label: Lubombo region road
candidates.source: MR8 corridor in the eastern Lubombo lowveld
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Different side of the country from the batch-001 Malkerns candidate (~77 km), on a numbered regional road rather than valley farmland.

candidates.label: A2 near Mafeteng
candidates.source: A2 road through the Lesotho lowlands
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. The lowland A2 is a populated trunk route, far more likely to be driven than the batch-001 high mountain pass (~180 km away).

candidates.label: A104 through the Rift Valley
candidates.source: A104 trunk road north-west of Naivasha
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Kenya's A104 is the country's main highway corridor. ~96 km from the existing Nairobi entry.

candidates.label: N1 coastal road near Takoradi
candidates.source: N1 coastal highway on the edge of Takoradi
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. Ghana's N1 is the primary coastal highway; ~58 km west of the batch-001 Cape Coast candidate.

candidates.label: Stuart Highway, Northern Territory
candidates.source: Stuart Highway south of Tennant Creek
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. The Stuart Highway is the continent's north-south spine and comprehensively driven. ~920 km from the batch-001 Winton candidate.

candidates.label: Great Northern Highway, Pilbara
candidates.source: Great Northern Highway near Newman, Western Australia
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. A sealed mining-freight highway through the Pilbara — heavy traffic, so well covered, but visually featureless.

candidates.label: Adelaide Hills outskirts
candidates.source: Residential road in the Adelaide Hills
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. Third and final Australian entry; Oceania is below its continent floor and only Australia and New Zealand have dependable coverage.

candidates.label: State Highway 6 near Haast
candidates.source: State Highway 6 on the West Coast
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. A numbered state highway rather than a back road; ~155 km from the batch-001 Alexandra candidate.

candidates.label: State Highway 1, Canterbury Plains
candidates.source: State Highway 1 across the Canterbury Plains
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Flat irrigated cropland on the country's main highway — visually generic, which is exactly the Hard brief.

candidates.label: Dairy country, Taranaki
candidates.source: SH45 coastal dairy country, Taranaki
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. Third and final New Zealand entry, on the North Island so it shares no cluster with the two South Island candidates.

candidates.label: Ruta 5 near Chañaral
candidates.source: Ruta 5 (Pan-American Highway) through the coastal Atacama
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. The Pan-American is Chile's spine and continuously driven, unlike the batch-001 inland desert route ~250 km away.

candidates.label: Rural Chiloé Island
candidates.source: Ruta 5 corridor on Chiloé Island
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Temperate island farmland that reads as northern Europe — a properly misleading Hard guess, and it feeds the Islands collection.

candidates.label: Ruta 3 near Puerto San Julián
candidates.source: Ruta Nacional 3 along the Atlantic Patagonian coast
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Ruta 3 is the paved coastal trunk route; the batch-001 Ruta 40 candidate was inland and ~390 km away.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Rosario
candidates.source: Residential streets on the edge of Rosario, Santa Fe
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. Argentine cities are densely covered; ~300 km from Buenos Aires and far from both Patagonian candidates.

candidates.label: BR-101 near Ilhéus, Bahia
candidates.source: BR-101 federal highway through coastal Bahia
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. BR-101 is Brazil's main coastal federal highway; tropical Bahia is ~1,600 km from the batch-001 Serra Gaúcha candidate.

candidates.label: Farmland in southern Minas Gerais
candidates.source: BR-265 corridor near São João del-Rei
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. Colonial-era interior with distinctive architecture, so a fair Normal guess rather than a Hard one.

candidates.label: Panamericana Sur near Nazca
candidates.source: Panamericana Sur through the coastal desert
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Peru's principal paved highway; ~535 km from the batch-001 altiplano candidate and a completely different desert.

candidates.label: Ruta 9 near Rocha
candidates.source: Ruta 9 through eastern grazing country
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. A numbered national route ~330 km from the batch-001 Tacuarembó candidate.

candidates.label: Andean farmland in Boyacá
candidates.source: Ruta 55 corridor near Villa de Leyva, Boyacá
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. ~270 km from the batch-001 coffee-region candidate and on a numbered route.

candidates.label: Trans-Canada Highway, Saskatchewan
candidates.source: Trans-Canada Highway near Swift Current
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Endless prairie on the country's principal highway; both existing Canadian entries are coastal cities.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Halifax
candidates.source: Residential road on the edge of Halifax, Nova Scotia
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. Atlantic Canada is absent from the catalog and North America sits below its continent floor.

candidates.label: Mexico 1 near Cataviña, Baja California
candidates.source: Federal Highway 1 through the Baja desert
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Mex 1 runs the length of the peninsula and is well driven; boulder desert unlike anything else in the catalog.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Mérida, Yucatán
candidates.source: Residential streets on the edge of Mérida
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. ~1,000 km from both existing Mexican entries; Yucatán is a distinct region.

candidates.label: Guanacaste dry forest road
candidates.source: Ruta 21 through Guanacaste
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. A paved numbered route rather than the batch-001 unpaved Monteverde approach ~74 km away.

candidates.label: Cordillera Central mountain road
candidates.source: PR-143 along the Cordillera Central
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. US-standard signage on a Caribbean island is a useful mid-difficulty cue; also feeds the Islands collection.

candidates.label: Rolling farmland near Biei, Hokkaido
candidates.source: Prefectural road through the Biei hills, Hokkaido
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Japan has near-total coverage. Hokkaido's open farmland lacks the usual Japanese urban cues, and both existing Japanese entries are Honshu cities.

candidates.label: Provincial Highway 11, Hualien coast
candidates.source: Provincial Highway 11 along the east coast
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. ~137 km from the existing Taipei entry; the rural east coast looks nothing like the west-coast cities.

candidates.label: Route 1095 near Pai
candidates.source: Route 1095 through the Mae Hong Son hills
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Thailand is well covered; forested northern hills give none of the Bangkok cues the existing entry has.

candidates.label: Rural road, Jeju Island
candidates.source: Inland road on Jeju Island
candidates.rationale: Normal/rural. Volcanic island farmland with Korean signage — recognisable with thought, so Normal rather than Hard.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Cebu City
candidates.source: Residential road on the edge of Cebu City
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New country; the Philippines has broad urban coverage and adds Southeast Asian island suburbia.

candidates.label: Outskirts of Yogyakarta, Java
candidates.source: Residential road on the edge of Yogyakarta
candidates.rationale: Normal/suburban. New country; Java is densely covered and adds the world's fourth-most-populous country to the catalog.

candidates.label: Ring Road near Kirkjubæjarklaustur
candidates.source: Route 1 (Ring Road) across the southern sandur
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. The Ring Road is fully driven, unlike the batch-001 northeastern highland candidate ~207 km away.

candidates.label: E6 in Finnmark
candidates.source: E6 European route through inland Finnmark
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Arctic tundra on a numbered European route; ~1,400 km from the batch-001 Geiranger candidate.

candidates.label: E45 inland Norrland
candidates.source: E45 (Inlandsvägen) through inland Norrland
candidates.rationale: Hard/remote. Endless boreal forest — extremely hard to place. ~640 km from the existing Stockholm entry.

candidates.label: Countryside near Ronda, Andalusia
candidates.source: A-374 through the Serranía de Ronda
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. Dry Mediterranean hill country ~800 km from the existing Barcelona entry.

candidates.label: N2 through the Alentejo
candidates.source: Estrada Nacional 2 near Almodôvar
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. The N2 runs the length of the country and is well driven; ~160 km from the existing Lisbon entry.

candidates.label: N59 through Connemara
candidates.source: N59 national road through Connemara bogland
candidates.rationale: Hard/rural. New country; treeless Atlantic bogland is genuinely hard, and Ireland adds another Left-Side Driving island.
